ev.q: SOURCE: Provisional report: Adams PF, Heyman KM, Vickerie JL.
Summary Health Statistics for the U.S. Population: National Health Interview Survey, 2008.
Estimates are based on household interviews of a sample of the civilian, noninstitutionalized U.S. population.

methods_quotes.q: Estimates are age adjusted using the projected 2000 U.S. population as the standard population
